race.comment: HURRICANE HARLEY (7) has returned in great style, scoring first-up before finishing a long neck from the winner in third last time over 1200m at this track. Gains Willie Pike here, so it's hard to imagine him not playing a key role again. DIAMOND DANCER (13) came home strongly last start to finish second, beaten 3/4 of a length, over 1000m at this track when coming back from a break. Has a terrific record here with two wins and three minor placings from five starts. Among the leading chances. SIX SHOOTER (1) resumed over 1200m at this track last start and was too good for his rivals, scoring by a neck. Second-up record is strong and is among the better chances. SWINGMAN (4) finished third just seven days ago over 1000m at this track. On the quick back-up over more ground, which looks a good formula. FLASH DANCER (6) is racing in a rich vein of form with three wins from his past four and is capable of making an impression in this grade.
